rationale: The agent initially authenticated the user correctly and provided details about the Bluetooth speaker. However, the agent failed to obtain explicit confirmation from the user before stating what could be done regarding the cancellation of the Bluetooth speaker and the listing of alternatives. When the user requested to cancel the Bluetooth speaker, the agent failed to clarify the cancellation entails canceling the entire order without confirming it correctly before taking further action. Lastly, while the total price confirmation was accurate, the lack of correct handling of the cancellation request violates the policy.
